svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 03 · Davis · 01/12 The Quad (Legendary)
svg.desc: The big lawn in the middle of campus, under old shade trees. Bikes stream around it like water around a rock. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
